==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Aspose&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/AsposeTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Aspose&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using Aspose.Cells;
using VerifyTestsAspose;

// Verify.Aspose: Converts pdf, docx, xlsx and pptx documents to a png per page, plus a metadata and text snapshot.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Aspose
// Note: The licence is applied in code before the first verification, once per Aspose product in
// use: Aspose.Pdf.License, Aspose.Cells.License, Aspose.Words.License and Aspose.Slides.License.
// Note: The settings methods live in the VerifyTestsAspose namespace rather than VerifyTests, so
// the using above is needed.
// Note: One verification writes several files: metadata as text, a png per page or slide, and the
// deterministic binary document.
// Note: VerifierSettings.ExcludeTargets("xlsx") applies the same exclusion to every test instead
// of one.
// Note: The file based samples need sample.pdf and sample.xlsx in the test project, copied to the
// output directory.
public class AsposeTests
{
    // A pdf becomes one png per page plus a metadata snapshot holding the document properties,
    // the fonts and the extracted text, so a layout change and a text change are separate diffs.
    // Not run by default: needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable, and a
    // sample.pdf copied to the test output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable, and a sample.pdf copied to the test output directory.")]
    public Task Pdf()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf");
    }

    // Aspose types are verified directly, without going through a file, so a document built in
    // code is snapshotted as it is: one png per sheet and the properties as text.
    // Not run by default: needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable.")]
    public Task Workbook()
    {
        var book = new Workbook
        {
            BuiltInDocumentProperties =
            {
                Comments = "the comments"
            }
        };
        var sheet = book.Worksheets.Add("New Sheet");
        sheet.Cells[0, 0].PutValue("Some Text");
        return Verify(book);
    }

    // Rendering every page of a long document is slow and makes a noisy diff. This caps the png
    // snapshots at the first pages; the binary and metadata targets are unaffected.
    // The static form is used because several document extensions define PagesToInclude as an
    // extension method, and referencing two of them makes the fluent call ambiguous.
    // Not run by default: needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable, and a
    // sample.pdf copied to the test output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable, and a sample.pdf copied to the test output directory.")]
    public Task PagesToInclude()
    {
        var settings = new VerifySettings();
        VerifyAsposeSettings.PagesToInclude(settings, 1);
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf", settings);
    }

    // Rebuilding the workbook deterministically is the expensive part of an xlsx verification.
    // Dropping that target keeps the csv and metadata snapshots, which is usually what changed.
    // Not run by default: needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable, and a
    // sample.xlsx copied to the test output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs an Aspose licence in the AsposeLicense environment variable, and a sample.xlsx copied to the test output directory.")]
    public Task ExcludeXlsx()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.xlsx")
            .ExcludeTargets("xlsx");
    }
}

==== interactions

Warning licence-required: Aspose needs An Aspose licence: Aspose is commercial. Without a licence its renderers watermark the output and cap the page count, so no snapshot matches.
